## G6 — Dark theme overhaul (visibility + richness)

```
FitPilot G6 — dark theme redesign. Only ThemeData/token changes +
asset swaps; no layout changes. Update docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md.

New dark tokens (replace existing):
  bg #121110, surface #1C1A18, surfaceRaised #272420,
  hairline #3A362F, text #F2EFE9, textSecondary #BDB6AA (was too dim),
  accent #F08A5A (brighter for dark), accentSoft #42291D,
  success #7CC98B, warning #E8B24A, error #E5807D,
  highlight #E9C46A (NEW — sparing use: streak flames, achievement
  moments, selected-state glows). No blue anywhere.
Rules:
1. All text passes WCAG AA on its surface (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large) —
   add a contrast unit test iterating token pairs.
2. Replace every logo/illustration that has a white box in dark mode
   with the transparent variants; line-art illustrations recolor via
   theme (stroke = textSecondary, fill = accentSoft).
3. Selected chips/cards in dark get a 1 px accent border + accentSoft
   fill (currently invisible).
4. Elevation in dark = lighter surface (surfaceRaised), never black
   shadows.
5. Snackbars, dialogs, sheets audited on dark for contrast.
Golden-test the Today, Plan, Exercises screens in dark.
```

## G7 — Burn Plan v2.1: honest sessions + clear copy

```
FitPilot G7 — burn plan realism. Read docs/DOMAIN_RULES.md; core
formula unchanged (MET × 3.5 × kg / 200).

1. Add header line above options: 'Pick ONE — each option clears your
   surplus on its own.'
2. SESSION CAP: if computed minutes > 90, the card shows a split plan
   instead: 'Too big for one session — 3 × 45 min over 3 days' (split
   into ceil(minutes/90) sessions, round each to 5). Detail screen
   pinned button mirrors this.
3. If surplus > 2000 kcal, show a calm banner: 'Big day. Spread the
   burn over a few days — or let tomorrow's budget absorb part of it.'
   No shaming language.
4. Thumbnails on plan cards use the SAME ExerciseMedia widget as the
   library (currently inconsistent/missing on device).
5. Tests: cap boundary at exactly 90, split math, banner threshold.
```

## G8 — Profile, settings & interactive snackbars

```
FitPilot G8 — profile & customization. Read docs/UI_SPEC.md.

1. PROFILE: reorganize into collapsed groups (Account / Goals & body /
   Preferences / About) — one screen height without scrolling on
   412x915; each group opens an expanded section.
2. Rename 'cheat tolerance' → 'Daily wiggle room' with subtitle 'kcal
   you can go over before we plan a burn' + an info sheet explaining
   the 300 default with an example. Editable 0–500 step 50.
3. NEW SETTINGS (all persisted in profile/local prefs, all synced
   where sensible): units kg/lb, theme Light/Dark/System, week starts
   Mon/Sun, burn plan defaults (category + pace, reuse existing),
   reminder times for the two daily notifications, haptics on/off.
4. SNACKBARS: single AppSnackbar component — icon by type (success
   check / warning / error), surfaceRaised background, accent action
   button (e.g. 'Undo' after logging, 'Retry' on network errors),
   slide+fade in, swipe to dismiss, 3.5 s. Replace every raw
   ScaffoldMessenger call.
5. Tests: settings persistence round-trip, snackbar variants.
```


</USER_REQUEST>
